indicators.source: OECD quarterly national accounts (DF_QNA, T0102) · Statistics Iceland's GDP at current prices, króna million, seasonally adjusted, quarterly.
OECD quarterly national accounts (DF_QNA, T0102) · Statistics Iceland's GDP in chain-linked volumes, króna million, seasonally adjusted, quarterly.
OECD quarterly national accounts (DF_QNA, T0102) · Statistics Iceland's real GDP, seasonally adjusted, change on the previous quarter, to one decimal place.
OECD quarterly national accounts (DF_QNA, T0102) · Statistics Iceland's real GDP, seasonally adjusted, change on the same quarter a year earlier, to one decimal place.
OECD prices database · Statistics Iceland's national consumer price index, all items, monthly; change on the same month a year earlier, to one decimal place.
OECD prices database · Statistics Iceland's national consumer price index, all items, change on the previous month, not seasonally adjusted, to one decimal place.
OECD infra-annual labour statistics (DF_IALFS_UNE_M) · Statistics Iceland's labour force survey, unemployment rate, 15 and over, seasonally adjusted, monthly.

BIS central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL, M.IS, extended with the daily series D.IS) · the Central Bank of Iceland's key rate (seven-day term deposits), end of month, from June 2014; the current month shows the latest rate.

indicators.indicator: Exchange Rate Against the US Dollar
indicators.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as US$ per ISK 100 (100 ÷ the published ISK per US$), from 1981.

Statistics Iceland, external trade in goods (table UTA06001) · exports less imports of goods, krónur, monthly, from January 2011. January 2006 to December 2010 is the IMF's international trade in goods (ITG), US$ converted to krónur at the BIS monthly average rate, so the series changes source at the join.

Statistics Iceland, external trade in goods (table UTA06001) · exports of goods, free on board, krónur, monthly, from January 2011. January 2006 to December 2010 is the IMF's international trade in goods (ITG), US$ converted to krónur at the BIS monthly average rate, so the series changes source at the join.

Statistics Iceland, external trade in goods (table UTA06001) · imports of goods, cost, insurance and freight, krónur, monthly, from January 2011. January 2006 to December 2010 is the IMF's international trade in goods (ITG), US$ converted to krónur at the BIS monthly average rate, so the series changes source at the join.
World Bank BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS · current account balance, % of GDP, annual.
World Bank BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS · foreign direct investment, net inflows, % of GDP, annual.

IMF World Economic Outlook (GGXWDG_NGDP) · general government gross debt, % of GDP, annual · actual years only. The IMF's figures for the years after the one shown are projections, which this site does not publish.

IMF World Economic Outlook (GGXCNL_NGDP) · general government net lending (+) or borrowing (-), % of GDP, annual · actual years only. The IMF's figures for the years after the one shown are projections, which this site does not publish.
